# APHUG Study Buddy by C&C Digital Ventures

APHUG Study Buddy is a teacher-built AP Human Geography learning application designed especially for ninth-grade students. It provides unit review, CED-aligned practice questions, adaptive topic mastery, vocabulary flashcards, models and maps, AP-style stimulus practice, and point-by-point FRQ coaching.

The application requires no student login and collects no student identity. Learning progress remains in the student's browser on that device.
